name: Transaction Identifications 56
definition: Unique identifier of a document, message or transaction.

TradeIdentification.name: Trade Identification
TradeIdentification.definition: Reference assigned to the trade by the investor or the trading party. This reference will be used throughout the trade life cycle to access/update the trade details.

UniqueTransactionIdentifier.name: Unique Transaction Identifier
UniqueTransactionIdentifier.definition: Unique Transaction Identifier (UTI) as agreed with the other counterparty.

AccountOwnerTransactionIdentification.name: Account Owner Transaction Identification
AccountOwnerTransactionIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the transaction as known by the account owner (or the instructing party managing the account).

AccountServicerTransactionIdentification.name: Account Servicer Transaction Identification
AccountServicerTransactionIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the transaction as known by the account servicer.

MarketInfrastructureTransactionIdentific.name: Market Infrastructure Transaction Identification
MarketInfrastructureTransactionIdentific.definition: Identification of a transaction assigned by a market infrastructure other than a central securities depository, for example, Target2-Securities.

ProcessorTransactionIdentification.name: Processor Transaction Identification
ProcessorTransactionIdentification.definition: Identification of the transaction assigned by the processor of the instruction other than the account owner the account servicer and the market infrastructure.

NoAccountOwnerTransactionIdentificationR.definition: If no reference is available for the AccountOwnerTransactionIdentification, for example, the transaction was sent by fax, then the AccountOwnerTransactionIdentification must be NONREF.
